semantic.justification: Task76 adds original copy-reference context values, insertion-only global-name normalization, sparse column sets, ScFormulaCell copy-update/compile metadata and actual document/table/column copy traversal with boundary group joins. Compiled references remain owned by the existing token arrays; no formula-source reparse is used to relocate references. Native false returns, oldest on-move undo formula and optional block-position borrowing are retained. Non-copy shift/move engines and absent names/drawing/printing/validation/embedded/UNO/formatter services remain unrepresented. This prerequisite does not complete document CopyFromClip, paste history, EnterBlock or AutoSum acceptance; whole-module behavior/contract/default parity stays unverified.
